{{RV|type=function

|game1= tkoh
|version1= 1.00

|game2= arma3
|version2= 0.50

|gr1= Database

|descr= Remove class from Scripted Database. The function does not return the modified database but modifies the passed array directly.

|s1= [database, path] call [[BIS_fnc_dbClassRemove]]

|p1= database - [[Array]]: Database array
|p2= path - [[Array]]: Path to class to be deleted

|r1= [[Boolean]]: True if class was removed

|x1= <sqf>private _db = ["#MILLER", ["&KILLS", 1000], "#TERRA", ["&WEAPON", "MX 6.5mm"]];
[_db, ["terra"]] call BIS_fnc_dbClassRemove; // true
_db // ["#MILLER",["&KILLS",1000]]</sqf>
